cues.en: If it have a name, it's okay, else we will ignore it.
cues.zh: 只要有名稱就接受，沒有就忽略。

cues.en: Or you can completely turn this on, and then off, and then even the name is not needed, and then even the name is not needed, then it will take the folder name,
cues.zh: 也可以完全關閉驗證，這樣連名稱都不需要提供，會直接採用資料夾名稱，

cues.en: and choose as a name for the system.
cues.zh: 作為系統中的技能名稱。

cues.en: So you can get things out.
cues.zh: 這樣仍然能取得技能。

cues.en: If someone cannot follow the rules, you can loosen the rules up here.
cues.zh: 如果某些技能無法遵循規格，可以在這裡放寬規則。

cues.en: The other thing you can do is do filtering.
cues.zh: 另一種設定是篩選。

cues.en: So for example, you just get a bunk here, and in here, you can return true, if that specific tool,
cues.zh: 這裡可以提供一個回呼函式，針對特定技能回傳 true，

cues.en: because this will be called for each single tool, if it should be included, or if it should not be included.
cues.zh: 因為每個技能都會呼叫一次，用來決定是否包含該技能。

cues.en: So for example, we could go and say, skills.scriptfiles.count equals zero.
cues.zh: 例如可以設定 skills.ScriptFiles.Count == 0。

cues.en: So now it will only return skills that doesn't have any script files.
cues.zh: 如此就只會回傳沒有指令碼檔案的技能。

cues.en: So if we run it again,
cues.zh: 再次執行，

cues.en: we will now see that our skills, we only have two again, which is there.
cues.zh: 可以看到現在又只剩兩個技能。

cues.en: Employ, and speak like a pirate, and it says here the SQL formula was excluded, as it did not hit filter.
cues.zh: 分別是員工手冊與海盜技能，這裡也記錄 Secret Formulas 因為不符合篩選條件而被排除。

cues.en: We could have turned it the other way around,
cues.zh: 也可以反過來設定條件，

cues.en: and we could have gotten that we only got one, and two of them was thrown away, because they didn't have script files.
cues.zh: 這樣只會取得一個技能，另外兩個則因為沒有指令碼而被排除。

cues.en: So you have full control over everything that is about this, so it could say if the description mentions a certain word,
cues.zh: 因此你可以完全控制篩選邏輯，例如描述是否提到某個字詞，

cues.en: or the license is not MIT, or whatever you want to do.
cues.zh: 授權條款是不是 MIT，或是任何想要的條件。

cues.en: So those are the options for getting the skills themselves.
cues.zh: 這些就是取得技能時的設定。

cues.en: Then there's the instructions. There's no special things about that.
cues.zh: 接著是指示，這部分沒有太特別的設定。

cues.en: And then there's the tools, because the tools can get extra setups.
cues.zh: 再來是工具，工具可以使用更多額外設定。

cues.en: First of all, you can get a strategy for how you want to have these tools.
cues.zh: 首先，可以指定工具產生的策略。

cues.en: And by default, it's using the available skills and lookup tools that we just saw, but you can also say that each skill is a tool.
cues.zh: 預設採用剛剛看到的可用技能與查找工具，但也能讓每個技能各自成為一個工具。

cues.en: So if we do that, let's set a breakpoint here,
cues.zh: 切換成這種方式，再在這裡設定中斷點，

cues.en: we will now see that we get four tools.
cues.zh: 就會看到現在取得四個工具。

cues.en: We get the Employee Handbook as a tool by itself, the Secret Formulas as a tool, the Speak Like a Pirate, and our Read Skill File Content,
cues.zh: 員工手冊本身是一個工具，秘密公式是一個工具，海盜技能也是工具，另外還有 ReadSkillFileContent，

cues.en: which is out-of-the-box default every time.
cues.zh: 這個讀取工具預設每次都會提供。

cues.en: So then we turn each skill folder into its own skill.
cues.zh: 如此就會把每個技能資料夾轉成獨立工具。

cues.en: This might not be the best if you have a lot of skills, because then you are ending up spending a lot of tokens.
cues.zh: 如果技能很多，這種方式可能不是最好的，因為會占用大量 Token。

cues.en: The default is that you only get the two available lookup tools and the Read File tool by default, because then, no matter how many skills you put in,
cues.zh: 預設只會提供兩個查找工具，再加上讀取檔案工具，因此無論放入多少技能，

cues.en: you will only end up with three tools.
cues.zh: 最後都只會有三個工具。

cues.en: What you can do as well is control some extra options here.
cues.zh: 另外，也可以控制這裡的其他選項。

cues.en: So here we can control, for example, if we want to include the tool for Read Content.
cues.zh: 例如，可以控制是否加入讀取檔案內容的工具。

cues.en: If we don't trust the system to read any files, by default, this tool is actually set up that it can only read the files that are in the skills.
cues.zh: 如果不信任系統讀取檔案，先說明：這個工具預設只能讀取技能內的檔案。

cues.en: So behind the scenes, when it runs the tool, it will actually check, is it any of the files that are in any of the skills,
cues.zh: 背後執行工具時，會檢查指定檔案是否包含在其中一項技能的檔案清單，

cues.en: and if not, it will say it's not a valid file.
cues.zh: 如果不是，就會回報檔案無效。

cues.en: So it's not dangerous to do, other than what skills you have, and it can only read.
cues.zh: 因此除了你提供的技能內容之外，它不能讀取其他內容，而且只會讀取，不會寫入。

cues.en: But if you don't want it, you can simply go and say False here, and then we only get the two tools,
cues.zh: 但如果不想提供，也可以直接設成 false，這樣就只剩兩個工具，

cues.en: to Get Available and to Get Skill By Name.
cues.zh: 分別是 GetAvailableSkills 與 GetSkillByName。

cues.en: Similar, you see these tools, but you can go in and choose that they should be called something else.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這些工具的名稱也可以自行修改。

cues.en: So Get Available Tools could be called Boo.
cues.zh: 例如 GetAvailableSkills 可以改叫 Boo。

cues.en: So they are controllable, if you don't like the names I have chosen.
cues.zh: 如果不喜歡我選的名稱，都可以自行控制。

cues.en: The same, you can change the description, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 工具描述也一樣可以修改，還有其他設定。

cues.en: So that's for all these tools and description here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以控制各工具的名稱與描述。

cues.en: And the final thing you can do is, you can choose how each tool are being generated, in that you can choose, should it include the description,
cues.zh: 最後，也可以決定每個技能的定義如何產生，例如是否包含描述，

cues.en: should it include the metadata, should it include the files lists, and all these kinds of things.
cues.zh: 是否包含中繼資料、檔案清單，以及其他這類內容。

cues.en: And behind the scenes, each of the tool, we look in here, we can say AgentSkills.
cues.zh: 看看背後的個別技能物件，我們可以從 AgentSkills 中，

cues.en: Just take one of the skills.
cues.zh: 先取出其中一項技能。

cues.en: We can go in and say Get Definition, and we can also validate the result, if we want to validate it.
cues.zh: 然後呼叫 GetDefinition，也能視需要驗證結果。

cues.en: But we can get the definition, and then you will also be able to see how each tool are being presented to the LLM.
cues.zh: 取得定義後，就能看到每個技能會如何呈現給 LLM。

cues.en: So if we set a breakpoint here,
cues.zh: 如果在這裡加入中斷點，

cues.en: and run it, you will see that each skill will be shown as a skill, with the name and description, instructions,
cues.zh: 執行後，可以看到每個技能都會以技能形式呈現，包含名稱、描述、指示，

cues.en: and then the files, in this case the reference files, but if there was other files, and so on.
cues.zh: 以及檔案清單。這裡是參考文件，也可以包含其他檔案。

cues.en: So each of them are being presented in this manner, to the LLM, on the fly.
cues.zh: 每個技能都是在需要時，以這種方式提供給 LLM。

cues.en: And if you don't like that, you can, of course, just go in and use the raw skills, build your own definitions, build your own tools, if you want to.
cues.zh: 如果不喜歡，也可以直接使用原始技能物件，自行建立定義與工具。

cues.en: But out-of-the-box, I've made it as opinionated as possible, and as I would use it default.
cues.zh: 不過預設版本採用了我自己的設計取向，也就是我平常會使用的預設方式。

cues.en: So if we just go back to this, we get the three out-of-the-box tools.
cues.zh: 把設定改回去，就會取得三個預設工具。

cues.en: We get the good names, in my opinion.
cues.zh: 工具名稱在我看來也相當合適。

cues.en: Again, if you don't like them, you can overwrite them.
cues.zh: 同樣地，如果不喜歡，隨時可以覆寫。

cues.en: And from that, we just need to build our skills, and use them in the system, and everything is up and running.
cues.zh: 接著只要建立技能、加入系統使用，就能正常運作。

cues.en: So that's everything.
cues.zh: 這次的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
